metric_space_audit.explicitly_cross_modal_aligned: fused visual slots and audio slots; InfoNCE directly compares normalized slot0-to-slot0
metric_space_audit.not_legal_for_direct_audio_cosine: F34, K34, K4, raw visual tokens, and img_to_v outputs are attention/key/value spaces, not InfoNCE metric embeddings
metric_space_audit.direct_token_region_semantic_verifier: N/A: no trained token-level projection into the InfoNCE slot metric space
metric_space_audit.RECIPROCAL_L4: C_av=Qa0->K4. For each visual slot s, r_s=1-JS(Qv_s->Ka, Qa0->Ka)/log(2); H_va=sum_s ownership_s*r_s; H_recip=0.5*(C_av+H_va); E(M)=soft_fg_mean(H_recip)-soft_bg_mean(H_recip).

circularity.AUD_FINE_regeneration: not used as a verifier tensor
circularity.SEMANTIC_SLOT: not identical to AUD_FINE; uses InfoNCE slot similarity and visual ownership
circularity.RECIPROCAL_L4: partially circular: C_av is the coarse precursor of AUD; the reciprocal H_va term uses the separately trained Qv->audio-key versus Qa->audio-key agreement

metric_space_audit.local_evidence: Within DISAGREE20, choose the candidate value closer to H_sem or H_recip; common 80% remains AUD.
